title: BoigerAI
description: Hosted on a Raspberry Pi 5, this personal AI assistant runs tiny or quantized models locally and lets you add custom Ollama servers for larger models. Chat in your browser, view hidden “thoughts,” choose from available models, and save or discard sessions. It’s a concise proof-of-concept for fully self-hosted, edge-deployed AI.

title: Arcane Wonders
description: Arcane Wonders is a unique Minecraft game plugin that introduces advanced teleportation portals, offering an innovative twist to the in-game experience. By providing a streamlined and user-friendly interface, players can now effortlessly utilize the teleport command to either join specific players, travel to predefined locations, or even explore random destinations. Within the first week of publishing this plugin on a renowned public plugin store, it garnered an impressive 26 downloads, underscoring its appeal to the Minecraft community.

title: OXCHIBUS
description: ‘Oxford Chinese Businesses’ or ‘OXCHIBUS’ is a website dedicated to recording the history of the Chinese community in Oxfordshire, England. OXCHIBUS aims to record the history of Chinese owned businesses in Oxford between the year 1910 and 1990’s.

title: Lol Stats Reader
description: Lol Stats Reader is a web app developed using Nuxt that enables users to retrieve their League of Legends match history. Due to the Riot API's restrictions, direct calls from the frontend are not possible, and a secret key is required for authentication. To address this, our Nuxt server-side handles the API requests, ensuring secure and efficient data retrieval. Users can search for any League of Legends username, select a region, and view detailed match history, player level, and more.

title: CS50x Final Project
description: The CS50x Marketplace represents the culmination of my journey through the CS50x course. Crafted as a comprehensive e-commerce platform, it serves as a hub for those seeking distinctive secondhand items and handcrafted products. Built with Vue for the frontend and Flask powering the backend, this project encapsulates the full-stack skills and principles imparted throughout the course.

title: Pokedex
description: A recreation of the Pokemon Brilliant Diamond pokedex. Utilises custom made SVGs for certain assets for the scrollbar, background etc. The application uses the PokeApi to gather data for the pokedex. (Desktop only)
